markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (96%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive risk [F1], with drafted ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 orders pending confirmation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 96%, InSitu 4%, others <1% | Strong invasive score; 5% dataset ECE |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (alpha 10%, 90% coverage) | Single-class set; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | High reliability despite atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (78%–84% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match suggestion |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 5, 10) · ↑ invasive · Top contributor (+1.15, z=1.88) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot-check accuracy · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest valid signal (+1.07, z=1.35); 19/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules (z=-1.27, +0.94) [F4]; text-only, caption-inconsistent, 18/20 spot-check · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.82, z=2.17; 18/20 spot-check), contradicting measured nuclei · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclear morphometry** (regions 2, 8, 10) · context · Area 46 µm² (0th percentile [F7]); low shape variation (8th) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.009 to +0.006); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tumor remains duct-confined like contrast case BACH_0155 (InSitu, 68% similarity), since duct-confinement scoring is weak (12/20).
- Unreliable mitoses (0/20) and wrong-direction dead (97th percentile [F9]) or epithelial [F10] fractions inflate risk despite small nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 8, 10, 11**: Verify stromal invasion (risk 100%) before ordering drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 stains.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 5, 10**: Manually verify mitoses (unreliable, 0/20) and nuclear atypia against small measured nuclei.
3. **Regions 3, 7**: Inspect duct boundaries and stroma (lowest risk 81% in region 3) to exclude InSitu.

found: 'Gland / tubule formation' is tagged Validated but should be Weak (spot check 18/20, caption check failed).
The CONCH–MUSK row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
